concerns.text: Tasks T040-T048 (Tempo, Affect, Consolidation, Grammar, Control) and T049-T051 (Documentation) have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. These tasks implement unapproved scope (simulated reviewer feedback) not present in the ratified spec, leaving the spec's FR/SC set uncovered by these tasks and the tasks themselves without a spec anchor.

Task T001-SPEC-UPDATE is marked complete but addresses a contradiction between spec.md FR-001 (mandating 8-core parallelization) and the plan's sequential execution strategy. The task implies a spec change that is not reflected in the current spec.md artifact. There is no task to formally update spec.md to reflect the 'sequential execution' override, leaving FR-001 unmet by the current implementation plan.

Task T030-PRIMARY implements a gate to raise an AssertionError if text-based features are detected, which contradicts spec.md FR-011 (validate semantic features against a held-out text set) and FR-007 (extract semantic features using BERT). The task logic blocks the intended input (semantic features derived from text) rather than validating the source, leaving the spec's requirement for feature validation unimplemented.

Tasks T040-T051 reference specific external reviewer names (Dan Rockmore, Eric Kandel) in their descriptions. These names do not exist in spec.md, plan.md, or constitution.md as authorized entities. This creates stale tags referencing non-existent spec elements, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' principle.
